frames.caption: The buyer's request typed into the agent's composer on a phone, not yet sent.
Sent: the buyer's words in the thread and the agent's first step line turning.
The agent at work: step lines ticking off as the thread's line draws down.
The reply: the usual 10 l boxes can't arrive in time, so it would come as one-litre cartons; which one?
The same reply with its steps opened: request read, history, the assortment searched, live price for a few, the rest left out and why.
The three options in one-litre cartons, each with its fixed total, price per litre and Monday delivery.
"the first one" sent; the agent takes the order to the gate.
Over the 500 € the agent may spend alone: the dark slab, needs your OK, with OK with Face ID.
OK with Face ID tapped and signed with this phone's passkey: the card turns to OK given, OK'd by the kitchen manager.
Back in the thread: OK'd by the kitchen manager, the order placed at the quoted price for Monday.
